narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twenty six is the biggest number here, so fourteen times twenty six is larger.
<bookmark mark='both'/>But fourteen is also the smallest number here. One big number does not decide it.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>His reason looks at only one number, so it cannot be trusted.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says fourteen times twenty six is larger because 26 is the biggest number in sight. 14 × 26 = 400 − 36 but 16 × 24 = 400 − 16, so less is taken away from 16 × 24.
